rationale: The permit footnote '*1 When discharging.' explicitly qualifies monitoring frequencies bearing marker *1, establishing that those requirements apply only during discharge periods. This is the operative when-discharging applicability rule demanded by conditional_monitoring_applies. Under that rule, monitoring marked *1 is not required during no-discharge periods, so absence of such monitoring during those periods does not by itself establish missing-required-monitoring. The packet does not contradict this reading, and known_missing_information is empty.
